ocr.markdown:
Fern Garrick
Taco Dip
Spread 1 - 10½ oz cans of Bean Dip in bottom of tupper-
ware pie taken (pizza pan size). Mix w electric
beater - 1 pkg taco seasoning mix, 1 - 12oz carton
Sour cream and 1 - 8oz Phil cream cheese.
Spread over bean dip. Layer on: Shredded lettuce,
diced tomatoes. Then sprinkle w shredded American
cheese. let mellow in fridge for 1 hr. Serve w
Doritos.
